meaning:
προ-μοέω, -ῶ and depon. -έομαι, οῦμαι,
[in LXX: Dan LXX 11:37 (בִּין), Wis.6:7, al. ;]
1. to foresee.
2. to provide (RV, take thought for): with accusative of thing(s), καλά, Rom.12:17 (-ούμενοι), 2Co.8:21 (-οῦμεν).
3. to provide for (before περί, Wis, l.with): with genitive of person(s), 1Ti.5:8 (-εῖ, WH, mg., -εῖται).†
(AS)

renderings.bsb: we are taking great care to do

elsewhere.note: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith, and is worse than an unbeliever.
